executive_summary: Fed and BoC pricing both reproduce at their own recorded page as_of, which clears the blocker that failed the 08:52 round: the BlueGamma SOFR-OIS page read at 2026-10-26T21:30:03Z prints Hike 15% / Hold 85% / Cut 0% with a +4bp move off 3.88% (implied 3.92), identical to meetings.fed.pricing (0.15/0.85, 3.88 -> 3.92, stamped 17:06:18 ET); the CORRA-OIS page stamped 2026-10-26T22:03:16Z prints Hike 91% / Hold 9% / +23bp off 2.25% (implied 2.48), exactly the candidate's 0.91/0.09 and as_of 18:03:16 ET - the operator's note about a 94% -> 91% refresh on the hour is consistent with the two page vintages I captured. Official policy reproduces against primaries: the 16 Sep FOMC statement raised the target range 25bp to 3-3/4 to 4 percent by a 12-0 vote, the SEP median end-2026 dot is 4.1% with 16 of 18 dots at or above 4.125 (median arithmetic confirms the 16/18 claim), the 7 Oct minutes say 'most participants assessed that another increase ... would likely be appropriate by year end' and the staff path is higher for 2026-28 with 2% only in 2029; the BoC held 2.25% on 2 Sep (seventh consecutive hold) and the 28 Oct announcement + MPR is confirmed at 09:45 ET, with both blackout dates correct. Every macro print checked back to its primary: BEA Aug PCE 3.4% / core 3.0%, BLS Sep CPI 3.7% / core 2.6% (+0.6% m/m), Sep PPI 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y (largest since Mar 2022) with the ex-food-and-energy core at 0.7% m/m / 5.0% y/y, payrolls +29k with u3 4.2% (Jul -10k, Aug +133k revised), StatCan Sep CPI 3.1% (gasoline +27.8%, ex-gasoline 2.2%, CPI-trim 1.8% / CPI-median 1.9%), LFS -68k / 6.5% / participation 64.8%, Q3 BOS one-year expectations up again in September with recession planning 17% -> 6%, the September deliberations quote, Macklem's 17 Oct Globe interview (Brent ~US$110, July assumption US$75), the Waller/Jefferson/Williams/Cleveland/Daly/Bowman quotes, the G7 100M bbl release, and the BEA 29 Oct 08:30 PCE + Q3 GDP calendar entry. Weight arithmetic recomputes exactly (+2 base / +0.75 effective for the Fed, +6 / +5.0 for the BoC, mean |weight| 2.77 and 2.75, no weight >=5, the September CPI release split only by distinct facets), the live Polymarket books match the betting block within rounding, and the three prior minors are fixed (Reuters label, 74% -> 75%, BoC pricing no longer single-venue). Four minors remain, all next_cycle and none blocking: the BoC betting hold leg rounds 17.25% to 0.18; the Fed page has re-stamped to 17:30 ET with an unchanged print; centralbank.watch is model output (FRB/US), not a market venue; and the PPI previous y/y predates this release's August revision. The call is coherent with its pricing (Fed hold 85%, BoC hike 91%) and no divergence badge is warranted.
